# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `uv run sandbox data-dictionary`. Do not edit by hand;
     edit the operation's docstring or sandbox/web/record.py instead. -->

The record of a room is its event log, exported by the facilitator as
JSON or as CSV (one file per event type). Speech is never recorded: the
software cannot hear the call, and nothing here is audio or video.

Schema version: **1**. The version changes whenever a
field is renamed, removed or changes meaning.

## The JSON export

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | The version above. |
| `exported_at` | When the export was made (ISO 8601, UTC). |
| `anonymised` | True if names were replaced by pseudonyms. |
| `includes_written_text` | True if typed text is included. |
| `room` | `code` (null when anonymised), `game_slug`, `created_at`. |
| `participants` | One entry per person: `participant`, `seat_id`, `is_observer`, and `display_name` unless anonymised. |
| `events` | The event log in order: `seq`, `created_at`, `actor_seat`, `op_type`, `payload`. |
| `reflections` | Answers to prompts: `participant`, `prompt_key`, `visibility`, `created_at`, and `body` only when text is included and the person shared the answer. |

## Anonymising and written text

An anonymised export replaces each person with a pseudonym (`Participant A`, `Participant B`, ...) that is stable within that one export and means nothing in another. Seats are not people and keep their ids. The room code is left out.

Written text is left out unless the facilitator ticks "include written text". These fields are removed otherwise: `SetText.text`, `PushClassPrompt.text`. A reflection that its writer kept private is never included.

## CSV export

A zip with `manifest.json`, `participants.csv`, `reflections.csv`, and `events/<op_type>.csv`, one file per event type. Every events file starts with `seq`, `created_at` and `actor_seat`. A step of a `Transaction` is written to its own type's file with `parent_seq` (the transaction's `seq`) and `step` (its position). Lists are JSON in one cell.

## Event types

`op_type` is the operation's class name. `actor_seat` is the seat that acted (`room` for the platform itself). Every payload also has `op_id`, which makes a repeated request apply once.

### AcceptSwap

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `offer_id` | `str` |
